ai_summary: 3i Infotech Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary has secured a six-month purchase order valued at USD 132,000 (approx. INR 1.25 crores) from a new, leading automotive client in the United Arab Emirates for SAP migration and QA/UAT services. While the company explicitly states this amount is below materiality thresholds, it represents a positive strategic development, signifying an initial international engagement with a new customer account, with no immediate red flags identified.
